summary: A 12-voice wavetable synth firmware on Dinghy, with two wavetable oscillators per voice, an arpeggiator and two step sequencers sharing one clock.
features: 12 built-in tables plus 8 user slots from Serum, WaveEdit, Ableton or Surge
Resonant multimode filter, two envelopes, LFO, four-slot effects chain
Two 32-step sequencers with chords and a per-step modulation lane
8 factory and 32 user patches; browser tool for patches and tables
USB MIDI in and out, follows MIDI clock; USB audio input
Doesn't read other firmwares' data; switching away erases its patches

headings: the web tool: your own wavetables, patch library
